label: AI Insight UI — Ping
info: Boot ping subflow per FAP General Guideline §18 step 4 ("verify browser to backend transport with a ping test"). Receives FAP §9 command envelopes with action='ping' from the UI tab's route-outbound function and replies with a FAP §9 result envelope { ok: true, data: { pong: true, serverTs: <ms> } }. Used by services/ai-insight-ui/scripts/smoke-uibuilder-ping.mjs as the post-deploy CI gate. Phase 3's dispatcher will absorb this into the central switch.
